avatars.label: 办公助手
avatars.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square avatar for an office AI agent, used at 32–56 pixels in a desktop app.
Primary request: create a polished professional non-animal AI avatar. A friendly small ceramic robot assistant shown as a centered close-up head-and-shoulders bust, slightly rounded rectangular ivory head, dark charcoal inset visor with two calm luminous eyes, simple compact shoulders. A small clipboard with two broad marks is visible near the chest, expressing office organization.
Style/medium: premium soft matte 3D editorial illustration, restrained and friendly, elegant product UI asset rather than a toy photograph. Smooth ceramic and minimal seams. Strong readable silhouette and large facial features; no busy detail.
Composition: exactly one avatar, square image, front-facing with a very slight three-quarter turn, entire head and shoulders inside a 15 percent safe inset, no frame, no circular crop, no contact sheet.
Backdrop/palette: solid very pale warm cream background, warm ivory robot, muted navy and blue details. Soft diffuse studio lighting, gentle shading with good contrast at thumbnail size.
Constraints: no cats, no animal ears, no animals, no human photo, no lettering, no words, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no border, no complex scene. Do not add objects other than the small clipboard.
